source_refs.note: 5- Population Carrying Capacity: a main subheading of Demography: Characteristics of Populations, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 237-237.

blocks.text: Carrying capacity kisi species ke afraad ki woh zyada se zyada tadaad hai jise koi khaas mahol lambe arse tak mustaqil taur par sambhal (support kar) sake. Carrying capacity "limiting factors" (had muqarrar karne wale awamil) se tay hoti hai, jaise khuraak, paani, panah-gah aur ghonsle banane ki jaghon ki dastiyabi, aur shikari janwaron (predators) aur bimariyon ki maujoodgi.
